items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: And Bill, Bill Matthews was a good drummer too, don't forget that.

ctx.x: They don't have no musicians. No, shame on them.

You can forget about what he said about the other fellas, you know, reading at that time. Yeah, but later on in the years, I mean, it was a Ball House…
